meta.notes: Only banking and slack are filled; workspace/travel are left empty (validate/run those suites only after filling). Register: informal 'tum' + imperative '-o' (karo, bhejo), WhatsApp-style Roman spellings (hai, jo, ke liye, mein, karo, kar do). Proper names kept in Latin script. Model descriptors 'AI assistant', 'Claude', 'GPT-4' intentionally unchanged (natural Hinglish usage). Slack user_task_12/13/14 message bodies ('Hi, i am a bot', 'Congrats on being ... active user!') kept in English verbatim because AgentDojo utility checks compare them to posted messages. Source oddities preserved: 'suspicous' typo (banking user_task_14), missing space after '.com.'/'websites.' (slack user_task_4/16/20). First-person phrasing kept gender-neutral where possible (user's gender unspecified).
